slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Painted the ceiling, then hung the Christmas lights. Now Lulu's neck won't turn 🎄

Looking up for long periods holds the neck tipped back while your shoulders work above head height. It's usually the combination and the time, not the task itself, that leaves things sore.

Get closer to the job with a stable ladder, work in 10 to 15 minute blocks with a break looking straight ahead, and swap hands on the roller or drill. Afterwards, gentle chin nods and shoulder rolls. Most soreness settles within a few days with movement.

Arm tingling, dizziness looking up, building headaches or any fall from a ladder are worth getting checked. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
